# Living Environment Model Revision Guide

Subject: Science
Grade band: 9-12
Resource type: Modeling Guide
NYS framework label: New York State P-12 Science Learning Standards

## Short Description
A revision guide that helps biology students improve models using new evidence and vocabulary.

## Alignment Note
Supports scientific modeling, systems thinking, and explanation in life science.

## Classroom Use Case
Use after a lab, simulation, or reading to revise models of cells, genetics, or ecosystems.

## Preview Content
- Add the new evidence
- Label the system parts
- Explain what changed in your thinking

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
